references.text: The Lord said to Aaron that he should have no inheritance in the land, for the Lord himself is his portion and inheritance among the Israelites.
The Levites shall have no inheritance among the Israelites, but shall live on the tithes that the Israelites give as an offering to the Lord.
The Levites received no inheritance among the Israelites, confirming that they were set apart from the other tribes.
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance with their brothers; the Lord is his inheritance, just as the Lord had promised.
The Levite living in the towns must not be forgotten, for he has no inheritance with the other tribes.
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance; the Lord's fire offerings are their inheritance, just as He had said to them.
The tribe of Levi received no inheritance; the Lord, the God of Israel, is their inheritance, just as He had said.
The Levites were given no land as an inheritance, only towns to live in and pasturelands for their animals.
Ezekiel confirms that the priests shall have no inheritance in Israel; the Lord is their inheritance.
Paul refers to the principle that those who serve at the altar share in what is offered on it, and that those who proclaim the gospel should get their living from the gospel.
